findings.summary: Most advertised Domain task types are not covered by identically named capability task types.
findings.evidence: domain.json advertises nine applicability task types but exact capability coverage is incomplete.

findings.summary: Compatibility tool declarations omit mandatory source and target version arguments.
findings.evidence: devecocli check compat requires --source-version and --target-version after versions discovery.

findings.summary: The verification capability overstates test evidence relative to its declared tools and task coverage.
findings.evidence: No generic devecocli test command exists; project test, coverage, and self-inspection must be explicit overlay dependencies or exclusions.
